title: manisuris compressa
intro: Manisuris compressa, commonly known as Indian gentian or gentian, is a plant species that belongs to the gentian family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Manisuris compressa include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antidiabetic activities, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
